image_description: A surreal, AI-generated image depicting a hybrid object that merges a black audio cassette tape with a handbag. The top half resembles a standard compact cassette with visible spools and casing details, while the bottom half transitions into a transparent, crumpled plastic bag structure. A brown leather-like strap is attached to the left side, reinforcing the handbag interpretation. The background is plain white. There is gibberish text in the bottom left corner.
